#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    std::regex re("([\\s\\S])\\1*");
    int os = 0;
    for (std::sregex_iterator it(str.begin(), str.end(), re), end; it != end; ++it) {
        if (it->length() % 2 == 0) {
            ++os;
        }
    }
    std::cout << os << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
